parserRules.chineseUndefinedSerialization: JSON omits an undefined chinese property. chinesePropertyStates explicitly records undefined for each omitted property.
parserRules.split: Split only on ASCII semicolon or fullwidth semicolon, trim each segment, and drop empty segments.
parserRules.alignment: Chinese is attached only when the nonempty English segment count is positive and equals the nonempty Chinese segment count. Any mismatch suppresses every Chinese segment.
parserRules.component: UsagePatternList returns null for no English items. Otherwise it emits a bold English item, and emits small Chinese text only when item.chinese is truthy.
parserRules.callSite: WordDetailScreen.tsx lines 182–183 select approved overrides then fall back to word data. Line 357 renders the section only when usagePattern is truthy. The town drawer embeds WordDetailScreen.
parserRules.slashCommaAlternatives: Slashes, Chinese enumeration commas and commas do not create parser groups. Grouped alternatives can therefore be structurally valid. Equal counts alone do not establish semantic correctness.
